question: How does abstaining from food during the day affect death by aging?
premises: Non-eating during the day is practiced.
Death associated with aging is the concern.
The practice leads to overcoming that death.
inference: By abstaining from food during the day, one will overcome death by aging.
uncertainties: gamiṣyate with mṛtyuṃ may mean go to death or go beyond death; context suggests overcoming.
plain_english: By not eating during the day, one will overcome death by aging.
